title: Manager- Interior and Finishes, Kolkata
description:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

**Job Description**

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced
**Manager - Interior & Finishes**
to lead the planning, execution, quality control, and delivery of interior fit-out and finishing works across residential, commercial, mixed-use, hospitality, and high-rise development projects. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring superior quality standards, timely project completion, cost optimization, and seamless coordination with internal and external stakeholders.

The ideal candidate should possess extensive experience in premium interiors, luxury finishes, project execution, contractor management, and client-facing project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Interior & Finishing Works Management

* Lead end-to-end execution of interior and finishing works across multiple projects.
* Oversee execution of flooring, ceiling systems, partitions, painting, cladding, joinery, modular installations, wall finishes, façade interfaces, and decorative elements.
* Ensure all finishing activities are executed in line with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Monitor productivity, workmanship, and adherence to project timelines.

Project Planning & Execution

* Develop detailed execution plans, work schedules, and resource deployment strategies.
* Coordinate site execution activities to ensure achievement of project milestones.
* Review project progress and implement corrective measures to mitigate delays.
* Ensure smooth interface coordination between civil, MEP, façade, and interior teams.

Quality Management

* Establish and maintain high-quality standards for all interior and finishing activities.
* Conduct regular inspections and quality audits at project sites.
* Monitor compliance with approved materials, mock-ups, shop drawings, and workmanship standards.
* Drive snag-free project completion and timely closure of punch-list items.
* Ensure successful testing, inspections, and handover processes.

Contractor & Vendor Management

* Manage interior contractors, subcontractors, and material suppliers.
* Review contractor performance and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Resolve technical and execution-related issues on site.
* Conduct progress review meetings and monitor contractor productivity.

Cost & Commercial Control

* Monitor project budgets and financial performance of interior works.
* Review BOQs, material quantities, and procurement schedules.
* Evaluate variation orders, claims, and change requests.
* Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization without compromising quality.

Design & Technical Coordination

* Collaborate with architects, interior designers, consultants, and project teams during design development and execution stages.
* Review design proposals, material specifications, shop drawings, and mock-ups.
* Ensure design intent is maintained throughout execution.
* Resolve technical challenges and recommend suitable finishing solutions.

Health, Safety & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
* Promote safe work practices across all interior and finishing activities.
* Support project teams in maintaining zero-incident work environments.

Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, project managers, procurement teams, and senior leadership.
* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, quality issues, and mitigation plans.
* Ensure client expectations are met throughout project execution and handover.

Team Leadership

* Lead and mentor project engineers, site managers, finishing engineers, and contractors.
* Drive team performance through coaching, training, and regular reviews.
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Management or Construction Management will be an added advantage.

Required Experience

* 15-20 years of experience in interior fit-outs, finishing works, and project execution.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, or mixed-use developments.
* Experience handling premium and luxury interior projects is highly preferred.
* Strong exposure to contractor management, project delivery, and quality assurance.

title: Manager – Revenue (Kolkata)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Bengali Subject Matter Expert – Audio Transcription (AI Training)
description:

What if your deep command of Bengali and your leadership instincts could directly shape how AI learns to understand spoken language? We're looking for a Subject Matter Expert (SME) based in the Kolkata region to lead our Bengali audio transcription project. You'll oversee a team of language labelers and reviewers, provide linguistic guidance, and help ensure consistent, accurate, and high-quality output across the project.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role that rewards sound judgment, clear communication, and a sharp ear for language. You'll guide a team through the natural messiness of real-world audio while keeping quality standards high and the team aligned.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: Hours may vary based on project demands, team needs, and project volume

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and support a team of Bengali-specific labelers and reviewers throughout the project
* Serve as the primary language and project subject matter expert, providing guidance on transcription, labeling, and language-specific questions
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality standards are maintained across all project work
* Monitor team performance and identify recurring quality issues, trends, or areas requiring additional guidance
* Conduct regular audits of labeling and reviewing work and provide actionable feedback
* Manage project-related communications and questions through Discord
* Host Office Hours to answer questions, clarify guidelines, and provide ongoing support to the labeling and reviewing teams
* Help identify ambiguities or gaps in project guidelines and escalate issues when necessary
* Participate in team meetings, calibration sessions, and project discussions

📍 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

We are looking for an experienced Executive Chef / Corporate Chef to lead our culinary function across multiple outlets.

This is a leadership role for a chef who combines strong culinary fundamentals, multi-cuisine expertise, product development, operational understanding and the ability to build systems that deliver consistency at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Product Innovation & Menu Development

• Lead new product and menu development across cuisines and formats.

• Develop, test and standardise new recipes while maintaining consistency in taste, presentation, yield and commercial viability.

• Identify emerging food trends and translate relevant trends into practical, scalable products.

• Drive periodic menu innovation and product refreshes based on customer preferences and market trends.

• Take overall ownership of product consistency across all units.

• Establish and monitor standard recipes, preparation methods, portioning, plating and finishing standards.

• Identify gaps in execution and implement corrective measures.

• Establish efficient production and mise-en-place systems for individual outlets.

• Improve kitchen productivity, utilisation of manpower and overall operational efficiency.

• Work closely with operations teams to ensure culinary systems are practical and consistently implemented.

4. Food Costing, Yield & Commercial Understanding

• Develop and maintain recipe costing and yield standards for products.

• Monitor food cost, portion control and wastage across units.

• Work with the management and operations teams to improve product profitability without compromising quality.

• Assist in evaluating ingredients, alternatives and vendor products from both culinary and commercial perspectives.

5. Team Building, Recruitment & Training

• Participate in recruitment and selection of culinary team members, particularly at CDP and above levels.

• Build and develop a strong culinary team across outlets.

• Conduct regular training on recipes, techniques, processes, hygiene, food quality and kitchen discipline.

• Develop training systems that allow culinary standards to be replicated consistently across locations.

6. New Outlet Planning & Set-Up

• Work closely with the management and project teams during new outlet development.

• Plan kitchen layouts, equipment requirements and operational flow.

• Prepare manpower requirements and kitchen organisation plans for new units.

• Assist in production planning, inventory planning and back-of-house infrastructure.

• Ensure kitchens are designed around practical workflow, productivity, food safety and scalability.

7. Hygiene, Food Safety & Kitchen Standards

• Take responsibility for maintaining high standards of kitchen hygiene and food safety across all units.

• Ensure compliance with established hygiene, storage, handling and production protocols.

• Establish systems for monitoring and maintaining these standards consistently.

PRE-REQUISITES

• Minimum 10 years of professional culinary / food production experience.

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an Outlet Chef, Head Chef or equivalent leadership position.

• Strong hands-on understanding of multi-cuisine food production.

• In-depth technical knowledge of cooking techniques, ingredients, preparation methods and kitchen processes.

• Strong palate and ability to evaluate taste, balance, texture, consistency and presentation.

• Experience in recipe development, standardisation and product innovation.

• Strong understanding of kitchen operations, production planning, manpower deployment, inventory and food costing.

• Ability to train, mentor and build culinary teams.

• Willingness to travel across existing and new units as required.

• The candidate should be equally comfortable with culinary creativity and operational discipline.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who can think beyond an individual kitchen.

Someone who can take a food idea from concept → recipe development → trials → standardisation → costing → training → production → execution across multiple outlets.

More importantly, we are looking for someone who is passionate about building something and growing along with the company.

This is not simply a role for someone looking for the next designation. We are looking for a culinary professional who wants to take ownership, contribute ideas, build teams, create systems and evolve with a growing food business.

As the company grows, we want the person in this role to grow with it, taking on greater responsibility and becoming an integral part of the company’s culinary journey.

The role requires a chef who enjoys being on the floor, tasting food, solving operational problems, developing people and continuously improving the product.

If you believe you can build great food and build the systems that allow great food to be replicated at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
  
  
Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
  
  
Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
  
  
Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
  
  
Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
  
  
Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
  
  
**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
  
  
In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
  
  
Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
  
  
Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
  
  
Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
  
  
**Portal Management**
Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
  
  
Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
  
  
Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
  
  
Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
  
  
Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
  
  
**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
  
  
Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
  
  
Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
  
  
**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
  
  
Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
  
  
In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

This role holds direct accountability for the full IT support pyramid — overseeing both the Service Desk (L1/L2) and Infrastructure Operations (L3) functions — ensuring that all Cyncly employees receive a high-quality, reliable, and secure technology experience.

As Head of IT Operations brings a broader strategic mandate: shaping the operational model, driving organizational maturity, managing vendor and stakeholder relationships, and acting as the senior internal IT authority at the Kochi site. The role requires an experienced, people-first leader who combines deep technical understanding with a strong service culture, ITIL discipline, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Organizational Management**

* Provide overall leadership, direction, and mentoring to both the Service Desk (L1/L2) and Infrastructure Operations (L3) teams, building a unified, high-performance IT operations function.

* Establish clear performance expectations, conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and create individual development plans to grow talent within the team.
* Champion a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, technical excellence, and psychological safety across the IT operations function.

With the new product line and intense demand from international markets, the company is on a path to hypergrowth.
  
  
**Role Overview**
You look after financial planning, controlling, and the reports people actually use.
  
  
The main question in this job is simple:
  
  
L1 : Once the money is in the bank, how is it being used?
  
  
L2 : Whats the better way to use it?
  
  
You also keep the company fund-raise ready. That means regular MIS, records in order, and filings, approvals, and certifications done on time.
  
  
This is a roll-up-your-sleeves role. You write the SOPs, put the processes in place, and run them yourself /closely work with operations team while you own the end results.
  
  
**Finance Experience In a Manufacturing Company Matters.**
**What you will do**
Cost, budgets, and reporting
  
  
Track how money is used after it comes in: cost structure, cost norms, and spend against the plan.
  
  
Say what a better use of that money looks like, and work it through with the operations team. You own the end result.
  
  
Work with other teams on the annual operating plan, follow it through the year, and set cost norms.
  
  
Run budgeting and forecasting so the plan stays accurate and lines up with what the company is trying to do.
  
  
Get MIS, cash flow, and Budget vs Actual out on time, with the numbers right.
  
  
Set up a regular reporting cadence. Call out variances, find out why, suggest a better use of the money, and follow up until it is done.
  
  
Give the CEO and other leads a clear picture of cash, cost, how the business is doing, and where the money would be better used.
  
  
Controls, compliance, and staying fund-raise ready
  
  
Put controls in place so company assets are safe, and the numbers can be trusted.
  
  
Keep books, records, and statutory filings in shape for a fundraise: regular MIS, a clean trail, and paperwork that holds up when someone checks it.
  
  
Handle filings, approvals, and certifications, including forex. Work with auditors, tax authorities, banks, and other financial institutions.
  
  
Stay on top of audits through the year, so nothing is left to the last month.
  
  
Watch for rule changes that aﬀect finance, and update how we work.
  
  
Day-to-day finance
  
  
Run the daily work of the finance team.
  
  
Write the SOPs for close, reporting, payments, compliance, and documentation, put them in place, and run them yourself.
  
  
Where the work sits with operations, work closely with that team and still own the end result.
  
  
Work with other teams so financial processes are tighter, and cost and cash numbers are easy to get.
  
  
Join planning conversations and bring the numbers: what things cost, and where the money would be better used.
  
  
What we are looking for 5+ years in finance, with a good part of that in a manufacturing company.
  
  
You have built SOPs and finance processes yourself, and run them while working closely with operations. You owned the end result.
  
  
You have owned MIS, cash flow, Budget vs Actual, annual plans, and cost control, and you have pointed to a better way to use the money.
  
  
You know Indian filings, approvals, certifications, and forex, and you have worked with auditors and tax authorities.
  
  
You know US and EU tax law, and forex and customs.
  
  
CA, MBA, or CFA is a bonus and is not required when the experience is strong.
  
  
You have used new AI tools to get work done faster, and you are willing to keep adopting them. This is a must.
  
  
You write and speak clearly with founders, other leads, auditors, and banks.
  
  
You are comfortable in a fast-moving manufacturing company that is still building its finance systems, and you will do the detailed work.

You play a key role in driving hypergrowth for unique & premium product lines, with very large enterprise customers across the USA and the EU.

You work closely with the founders on strategic decisions and the long-term company roadmap.

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 22,000 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a skilled
**Senior Quantity Surveyor- Civil (Pre-Contract)**
to join our team in Bangalore team, MESA project support. The role involves managing cost planning, estimating, measurement, and commercial analysis for GCC buildings and infrastructure scope - pre-contract stage. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurate Cost Planning, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), tender documentation, value engineering support, and commercial input to ensure competitive and compliant bids within the GCC.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review design drawings, specifications, and scope documents for buildings and infrastructure packages.
* Perform detailed quantity take-offs at concept, schematic, and detailed / tender design stages.
* Prepare accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and cost estimates in compliance with POMI, NRM, and CESMM standards as applicable.
* Support preparation of tender submissions, cost schedules, and rate build-ups.
* Conduct market research on material, labour, and subcontractor rates within the UAE.
* Participate in value engineering exercises, identifying cost optimisation opportunities.
* Assist in drafting tender and contract documents, ensuring commercial accuracy and clarity.
* Liaise with suppliers and subcontractors to validate rates and quotations.
* Provide commercial risk assessments, highlight discrepancies, and raise clarifications where required.
* Support bid review meetings and negotiations with consultants/clients.
* Maintain accurate cost data, benchmarks, and ensure timely delivery of all pre-contract outputs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related.
* Working towards or having achieved professional certification from a recognised body (e.g., MRICS, CIOB).
* **3-8 years’ experience**
  in pre-contract quantity surveying, preferably in the UAE and KSA, or wider GCC.
* Strong working knowledge of recognised standards of measurement: POMI, NRM, and CESMM.
* Proven track record in cost estimation, BOQ preparation, and rate analysis for MEP works and site-wide utilities.
* Proficiency in measurement and cost management software (CostX).
* Sound understanding of tendering procedures, subcontractor pricing, and procurement.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills in English (Arabic is a plus).

Yulu is led by a mission-driven & seasoned founding team and has won several prestigious awards for its impact and innovation. Stay updated on the latest news from Yulu at https://www.yulu.bike/newsroom and our website, https://www.yulu.bike/. https://www.yulu.bike/.

**Role Summary**

Own financial modelling, forecasting, scenario planning, investor relations, and management reporting. Partner with Business Finance, Accounting, Tech & Data, and business teams to translate operational drivers into actionable financial insights, support fundraising and investor requirements, and deliver accurate, investor-ready board and management presentations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Modelling, Projections & Scenario Planning**

* Build, maintain, and continuously refine integrated financial models(P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and rolling forecasts.
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to stress-test assumptions and support strategic and fundraising decisions.
* Translate operational and business drivers into financial projections in partnership with business teams.

**Investor Relations**

* Prepare investor and lender communication materials — investor updates,fundraising decks, data room content and Q&A support — along with the trackers, covenant schedules and periodic information packs required under financing agreements.
* Support debt and equity fundraise processes end-to-end — investor communication, information requests, tracking of the fundraise pipeline, and coordinating due diligence with internal teams and advisors.
* Build and maintain market intelligence for the finance and leadership teams — track the performance of peer and comparable companies, benchmark key operating and financial metrics, and monitor sector, funding, and regulatory developments relevant to Yulu, to sharpen internal decision-making and investor conversations.

**Board Decks &Management Presentations**

* Build clear, well-structured board decks and management presentations that tell an accurate financial story.
* Own the analysis behind board and investor materials — financial performance packs, KPI dashboards and MD&A-style commentary for board meetings.

**Business Finance Partnership**

* Partner with the Business Finance team on recurring MIS, budget-vs-actual variance analysis and month / quarter-end close deliverables (includes City P&L, Cluster P&L, Usage-based P&L, Business Unit P&L, Unit Economics, etc.).
* Maintain and improve the templates, trackers and dashboards used for periodic management reviews.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Accounting, Investor Relations, the Business Function and the Tech & Data Function to deliver sharp, well-grounded analysis and the best outcomes for the business.
* Work with the Tech & Data Function to improve data availability and automate recurring analysis, reducing manual effort.
* Liaise with business unit owners to gather inputs for forecasts, budgets and periodic reviews.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in FP&A, investment banking, equity research, corporate finance or financial consulting.
* Very strong Excel skills — advanced financial modelling, complex formulas, pivot tables, and scenario/sensitivity tools; working knowledge of VBA is a plus.
* Solid financial expertise — strong grasp of financial statements, corporate finance principles and valuation concepts.
* Working knowledge of PowerPoint for building polished,investor-ready board decks.
* Excellent analytical and quantitative skills, with close attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to turn numbers into a clear narrative for senior stakeholders and investors.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or a related field; MBA (Finance), CA, or CFA is a plus but not mandatory.

We are seeking a forecaster to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics & Insights (CA&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This individual contributor role is responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving multiple forecast types across Ex-US markets - including short-term in-market demand forecasts, long-term strategic forecasts, patient-based epidemiology forecasts, and launch and event scenarios - in partnership with affiliate forecasting leads. The Senior Analyst is accountable for forecast model integrity, assumption discipline, and the business relevance of outputs delivered into brand planning, S&OP, and portfolio cycles.

**Forecast Model Development and Delivery:**

* Build and maintain a portfolio of forecasts across multiple IBU markets and brands, spanning short-term tactical forecasts (24-36 months), long-term strategic forecasts (10+ years), in-line product forecasts, and pipeline and BD forecasts.
* Apply the appropriate forecast methodology to each disease area, including patient-based approaches (prevalence, incidence, disease progression), demand-based approaches (trend, time-series, regression, exponential smoothing), and hybrid models that integrate both.
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses for market events, competitive entries, LOEs, pricing changes, indication expansions, and access scenarios across IBU geographies.

* Track forecast accuracy across cycles, perform variance analyses against actuals, and translate learnings into improved drivers and assumptions for the next cycle.

**Data, Methodology, and Tooling:**

* Work with IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, syndicated subnational data, claims, prescription data, and epidemiology sources to build robust market and patient views across Ex-US geographies.

* Partner with affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global IBU stakeholders to clarify intake, align on methodology, and walk through outputs, assumptions, risks, and scenarios.

**Process Improvement and Operational Excellence:**

* Identify opportunities to automate recurring forecast updates, standardize templates across markets and brands, and build reusable assumption libraries that improve speed and consistency.
* Contribute to building capability within the GCC pod, including knowledge sharing, documentation of best practices, and onboarding support for new analysts.
* Leverage AI and GenAI tools to accelerate data preparation, assumption research, deviation reasoning, and narrative generation within forecasting workflows.

* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.

**Experience:**

* Working knowledge of coding techniques such as Python, R, or SAS for data preparation, time-series analysis, and automation is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.

* **Analytical Rigor –:**
  Applies disciplined assumption management, sensitivity analysis, and accuracy tracking to every forecast deliverable.

title: Founder's Office – Real Estate Acquisitions
description:
**Meet Flent 👋🏼**
Renting in India can be a nightmare. Think about it: visiting countless houses, arguing over rent, losing money to brokers, sticking to 11-month contracts, and spending lakhs of rupees into furnishing. It's a lot — and honestly, we deserve better.
  
  
This is where Flent comes in. We're creating a new standard of urban renting for India.
  
  
Imagine walking into a home that feels like it’s straight out of a lifestyle magazine - fully furnished, beautifully staged, all you need to bring is your clothes and your vibe. No need to persuade landlords, no dealing with brokers, and no 11-month lock-ins. It’s not just a vision; it’s what we believe the top 1% in India truly deserves.
  
  
We started Flent because we were fed up. Trying to find a decent place in the city was a nightmare. But beyond the frustration was a deep-seated passion for home decor and an eye for detail that we couldn't ignore. Numbers revealed that ~$10 Bn is spent annually on urban renting — and that was the tipping point. It convinced us of the potential to craft the future of renting, designed for those who demand more and compromise less.
  
  
Flent is backed by top-tier VCs and angels. Since our inception in Jan’24, we’ve launched
**300+ homes**
, went viral on X more than we imagined, and crossed
**$3 Mn in annual GMV**
.
  
  
**Meet Your Team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑**
Hey — I’m Shail, co-founder & CEO at Flent 👋🏼
  
  
One of the most interesting things about building Flent has been seeing how different the two sides of our marketplace are.
  
  
Our demand side is sophisticated — young, tech-savvy customers who know exactly what a great consumer experience should feel like.
  
  
Supply is the opposite. Indian real estate is fragmented, relationship-driven, and still very early in getting organised. Information is hard to find, decision-making is messy, and the best opportunities rarely come to you.
  
  
The people who do really well on this side of the business have two things in common: they’re great at selling, and rejection doesn’t slow them down.
  
  
You have to love the hunt. Find people who don't want to be found. Get meetings that aren't easy to get. Hear no repeatedly. Build trust over months. And keep showing up until something moves.
  
  
And now, we're taking that same muscle into a much more open-ended problem.
  
  
After working with ~12 building owners in Bangalore, we've tasted some early success with institutional supply. We now want to go deeper — working with landowners, developers, investors and wealth managers to create and operate rental assets at a much larger scale.
  
  
There isn't really a playbook for this yet. Residential rentals in India are still early as an institutional asset class, and part of what we're trying to do is prove that these assets can be created, operated and invested in at scale.
  
  
**That messiness is exactly what makes this role exciting to me.**
You’ll report directly to me and work closely with Ashish, who leads Supply Growth at Flent.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for someone to help build the
**institutional acquisitions engine at Flent.**
Your job is to find opportunities, build relationships with the people behind them, underwrite the economics, and take the right ones all the way from a first conversation to a deal.
  
  
That could mean helping a landowner turn a building into a high-yield rental asset. Partnering with a developer on an upcoming project. Or starting with an investor’s capital and target return, and working backwards to find or create the right real estate opportunity.
  
  
This isn't a mature function with a fixed investment thesis, predefined deal structures, or a ready-made pipeline.
*Part of your job is to figure out what the playbook should be. This is more of a -1 to 0 journey first.*
**What You’ll Broadly Do**

* Find the people who control real estate Build relationships across Bangalore’s real-estate ecosystem — landowners, developers, investors, wealth managers, brokers, family offices and anyone else who can help us unlock institutional residential supply. Some opportunities will come inbound. A lot of the interesting ones probably won't.
* Originate opportunities before they become obvious Don't wait for a building to come onto the market. Map neighbourhoods, follow developers, speak to brokers, chase introductions, find owners, and create conversations where Flent can add value.
* Match capital with the right real estate opportunity Sometimes you'll start with an asset and figure out how to maximise its rental economics. Other times you'll start with an investor's capital and return expectations and work backwards to identify the kind of asset we should create or acquire.
* Underwrite what an asset could become Understand acquisition price, configuration, achievable rents, capex, operating costs, yield, appreciation assumptions, exit scenarios and IRR. Work with the broader Flent team to answer a simple question: if we were operating this asset, what could we turn it into?
* Take relationships all the way to a deal These won't always be quick transactions. Some relationships could take months. Understand what each stakeholder wants, build trust, navigate the economics, coordinate diligence and stay with an opportunity until there's a signed agreement — or a clear reason to walk away.
* Build the institutional acquisitions playbook Treat every conversation and every deal as data. Figure out which asset profiles work, where the best opportunities originate, which partners we should spend time with, why deals die, which structures make sense, and what eventually becomes repeatable.

**What your day-to-day will look like**

* Mapping landowners, developers, buildings, investors and other potential partners across Bangalore
* Reaching out cold, chasing introductions, meeting brokers, attending industry events and finding unconventional ways to get in front of asset owners
* Spending significant time on-ground looking at buildings, plots, neighbourhoods and potential acquisition opportunities
* Meeting landowners and understanding what they're trying to achieve with their asset
* Meeting investors and understanding their capital, return expectations, investment horizon and risk appetite
* Building underwriting models around rents, acquisition price, capex, yields, cash flows, appreciation and potential IRRs
* Working with our supply, design and operations teams to understand what an asset could become under Flent
* Building proposals and investment cases for potential partners
* Negotiating commercials and working through diligence until a deal closes
* Maintaining a live pipeline of opportunities and being relentless about moving each one forward
* Building relationships that may not result in a deal today, but could become valuable months or years from now

**We’re looking for someone who**

* Has 3–7 years of experience across real-estate acquisitions, investments, transaction advisory, developer BD, real-estate private equity, family offices, hospitality expansion, managed offices, co-living, or another relevant real-estate role
* Understands real estate beyond just buying and selling — you’re curious about what makes an asset valuable and what can make it more valuable
* Is comfortable with numbers and can think through rental yields, cash flows, capex, appreciation, exit assumptions and IRRs
* Is equally comfortable inside a spreadsheet and across the table from the person who owns the building
* Loves the hunt. Finding an opportunity that nobody sent you is more exciting than working through an inbound pipeline
* Knows how to build long-term relationships. You understand that a ₹10 Cr conversation cannot always be closed in three follow-ups
* Has strong commercial judgment — you can understand what the other side wants without forgetting what needs to work for Flent
* Is comfortable walking away from an opportunity when the economics don't make sense
* Can operate in ambiguity. There isn't a perfectly defined acquisition box waiting for you
* Is resourceful enough to figure out who owns an interesting building, how to reach them, and what would make them take your call
* Can move between strategy and ground execution without treating either as beneath you
* Has enough curiosity to understand real estate, capital, consumer demand and operations together
* Doesn't need follow-ups to close loops
* Wants to build something, not simply inherit a playbook

**Compensation, Benefits & Perks**
The total cash compensation for this role will be competitive and based on experience. You’ll be eligible for fat incentives, ESOPs & standard perks beyond the cash component.
  
  
The role is based in
**Indiranagar, Bangalore**
. This is not a remote role, and a meaningful part of the job will happen outside the office — meeting people, seeing assets and understanding the market on-ground.
  
  
Read more about our benefits, leave policy, perks, etc. here.
  
  
**Our Values**
It is very important that you understand the culture and vibe of Flent before applying.
  
  
We constantly evolve as individuals and as an organization, but we aim to keep these values at the core of how we operate till the day this company exists.
  
  
**Our Team**
Detailed bios of all our team members are here.
  
  
**The Hiring Process**
We do not follow a fixed process for hiring at the moment. You’ll be doing a couple of calls or in-person interviews with all three co-founders. This might be paired with a time-bound assignment & a call with one of our investors.
  
  
Overall, we gauge your intellect, your curiosity and your vibe to figure out if you’re the right fit for Flent.
  
  
It is difficult to respond to every application we receive, so you’ll hear from us only when we want to proceed forward. And once that happens, we promise to complete the entire process within 2 weeks.
  
  
**Referral Reward**
If you know someone great for Flent, let us know. Once they’re with us for 90 days, you get to choose a reward: a 30-day stay in a Flent property, a INR 20,000 donation to a charity of your choice, or brand gift cards worth INR 25,000.

Role: Assistant Program Manager – New Product Design & Launch

The role involves working closely with Design, Buying, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Content, and Warehouse Operations teams to ensure timely product launches, maintain data accuracy, identify market opportunities, and improve overall operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, an understanding of product trends, excellent coordination abilities, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Launch Management**

* Manage end-to-end product launches across categories such as Silver, Gold, Demi Fine, Personalised, and other emerging product categories.
* Coordinate with Design, Buying, Content, Editing, Merchandising, Supply Chain, and Warehouse Operations teams to ensure timely execution of launches.
* Ensure 100% accuracy of SKU attributes, including pricing, product titles, cataloguing, tagging, inventory, and other relevant information before launch.
* Track launch timelines, identify bottlenecks, resolve dependencies, and ensure adherence to planned launch schedules.
* Manage SKU creation, category setup, and product attribute updates on internal systems such as GUTS and Shopify.
* Maintain launch trackers and dashboards to monitor progress, identify pending SKUs, and improve launch efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve inventory utilization by prioritizing the launch of available but unlaunched warehouse inventory.

**2. New Product Development & Assortment Planning**

* Work closely with Buying and Design teams to plan and execute new product development based on business requirements, customer preferences, and market trends.
* Conduct trend forecasting, competitor benchmarking, and market research to identify emerging designs, motifs, categories, and product opportunities.
* Analyse best sellers, slow-moving products, and kill SKUs based on sales performance, design, motifs, plating, and price points to improve future selections.
* Identify assortment gaps across categories and develop mood boards and product recommendations to guide the Buying and Design teams.
* Support category expansion through research on new product segments, customer preferences, pricing strategies, and market opportunities.
* Track the performance of newly launched products and use insights to improve future assortment and product selection decisions.
* Ensure product selections are commercially viable by considering trends, COGS, pricing, inventory availability, and category performance.

**3. Data Analysis & Business Insights**

* Conduct SKU-level analysis to identify pending launches, operational challenges, and opportunities to improve product availability.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) of pending and underperforming products and recommend actionable solutions.
* Analyse category-wise, price-bucket-wise, motif-wise, and design-wise performance to support data-driven assortment decisions.
* Gather and analyse customer and store staff feedback to identify product improvement opportunities and understand factors affecting sales.
* Track product performance, sales trends, and assortment effectiveness to provide actionable recommendations to Buying and Design teams.

Conduct product policy and attribute reviews to ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with business requirements.

**4. Project Management & Process Improvement**

* Independently manage cross-functional projects related to product launches, category expansion, assortment optimization, and operational improvements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline existing NPD and launch processes, improve turnaround times, and reduce manual effort.
* Maintain NPD dashboards, OKR trackers, collection-level dashboards, and other project documentation to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure project milestones, deliverables, and dependencies are tracked and completed.
* Drive initiatives related to inventory optimization, SKU data accuracy, product policy updates, and process standardization.
* Prepare monthly project updates and performance reports to communicate key achievements, progress, and areas requiring attention.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Act as a key coordination point between Design, Buying, Merchandising, Content, Editing, Supply Chain, Warehouse Operations, and other relevant teams.
* Ensure clear communication of product requirements, launch priorities, timelines, and project updates across stakeholders.
* Collaborate with leadership teams to understand business priorities, track product selection requirements, and ensure assortment gaps are addressed.
* Facilitate timely resolution of operational dependencies and challenges to ensure smooth execution of launches and strategic projects.
* Maintain centralized product and collection information to improve accessibility, transparency, and collaboration across teams.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret product and sales data.
* Good understanding of product development, buying, merchandising, and assortment planning.
* Knowledge of jewellery trends, market research, competitor analysis, and customer preferences.
* Strong project management, planning, and execution skills.
* Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination abilities.
* High attention to detail, particularly in SKU data management and product launches.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and meet strict timelines.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel, dashboards, and data management tools.
* Familiarity with Shopify, product information management systems, and inventory management platforms is an advantage.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion Management, Retail Management, Business Administration, Merchandising, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in New Product Development, Buying & Merchandising, Product Launch Management, Category Management, or related roles.
* Experience in jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, e-commerce, or retail is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Product Launch Execution: Timely and accurate launch of SKUs across assigned categories, with adherence to planned launch timelines.
* New Product Development: Effective assortment planning, identification of market trends, and development of commercially relevant product selections.
* Product Performance Analysis: Regular analysis of launched products, best sellers, and underperforming SKUs to improve future selections.
* Process Efficiency: Improvement in launch turnaround time, data accuracy, inventory utilization, and operational processes.
* Project Ownership: Successful execution of assigned strategic projects and initiatives within defined timelines.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Effective coordination across teams to ensure smooth workflows, timely deliverables, and achievement of business objectives.

This position allows Collectors to focus on cash collection while improving efficiency, reducing payment delays and accelerating customer onboarding.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
  
  
  
  
**Customer Onboarding**

* Coordinate customer onboarding activities prior to collections.
* Validate customer account setup requirements.
* Ensure all required information has been received before invoices become due.
* Prepare and maintain a standardized Customer Onboarding Package to ensure customers receive all required payment, tax, banking and compliance documentation at the beginning of the customer relationship.

**Purchase Order Management**

* Verify Purchase Orders (POs) before invoices are issued.
* Follow up with Sales and customers regarding missing or incorrect POs.
* Track PO-related issues until resolution.

**Vendor Registration**

* Complete customer vendor registration processes.

* Submit and monitor registration requests.

* Ensure customer accounts are fully operational before being handed over to Collections.
